own_solution.law: Snell's law n1 sin(theta1) = n2 sin(theta2)
assumptions: light travels from medium 1 into medium 2; no total internal reflection since n2 > n1

defect_reasons.other: TF598 ('was tilted 11 deg farther ... before the refraction was observed') admits a reading in which the tilt was a prior state later undone, and it overrides the stated 40 deg incidence; the intended R reading (incidence 51 deg at observation) is the more natural one, parallel to T8078, so this is wording ambiguity rather than an error.

notes: Checked answers: base sin(theta2)=sin40/1.5=0.42853 -> 25.374 deg. R values: q=6 -> theta1=46, sin=0.71934/1.5=0.47956 -> 28.657; q=11 -> 51, 0.77715/1.5=0.51810 -> 31.205; q=14 -> 54, 0.80902/1.5=0.53934 -> 32.639. All match the certified answers. Relation, units (dimensionless indices, degrees) consistent. D claims for camera tilts (TA3DE, T0468) and earlier-experiment laser tilt (TB841, T77F8) hold. TB841/TF598 share the number and unit (11 deg) and differ only in the time attachment ('in an earlier experiment' vs 'before the refraction was observed'): the minimal-pair claim holds. TA3DE is honestly declared not a minimal pair of T8078. Disagreements with my pass 1: (1) I flagged rendering_not_minimal for T77F8/T0468 vs TB841/TA3DE; the authors declare these as numeral-free controls by design, not same-number variants, so this flag is withdrawn. (2) I flagged TF598 as a high-severity contradiction with the stated 40 deg; on reflection it is the same device as T8078 (a change applied to the stated set-up before observation), which I accepted as R, so treating one as a contradiction and not the other is inconsistent; I downgrade it to a medium wording ambiguity.
